en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard. The front shows three images: on the left a bust of Count Gyula Zichy, in the center the richly decorated main altar of a church with a statue of Christ and ornamental railings, and on the right a bust of Pope Pius X. Hungarian captions identify the figures and scenes, and at the bottom the city name "Pécs" and the institution name "It. Pius-Kollégium" are printed. The reverse has the typical divided postcard layout with Hungarian printing, including a note about domestic postage rates and the printer's mark from Budapest.
